title: Helpers--Roofers
description: Help roofers by performing duties requiring less skill. Duties include using, supplying, or holding materials or tools, and cleaning work area and equipment.

tasks.text: Check to ensure that completed roofs are watertight.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Installation inspection requires on-site physical check

dwas.name: Inspect completed work to ensure proper installation.

tasks.text: Set ladders, scaffolds, and hoists in place for taking supplies to roofs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Erecting temporary structures requires physical assembly
physical manipulation — Work site cleaning is physical labor
physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of construction tools

tasks.text: Provide assistance to skilled roofers installing and repairing roofs, flashings, and surfaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assisting of skilled trades on site

dwas.name: Assist skilled construction or extraction personnel.

tasks.text: Locate worn or torn areas in roofs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical locating of worn parts needs hands-on presence

dwas.name: Locate equipment or materials in need of repair or replacement.

tasks.text: Sweep and clean roofs to prepare them for the application of new roofing materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal of worn materials

dwas.name: Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.

tasks.text: Perform emergency leak repairs and general maintenance for a variety of roof types.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Roofing requires hazardous manual labor

tasks.text: Unload materials and tools from work trucks, and unroll roofing as directed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical loading in construction or extraction

dwas.name: Load or unload materials used in construction or extraction.

tasks.text: Hoist tar and roofing materials to roofs, using ropes and pulleys, or carry materials up ladders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual moving of construction materials on site

dwas.name: Move construction or extraction materials to locations where they are needed.

tasks.text: Clear drains and downspouts and clean gutters.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Work site cleaning is physical labor

tasks.text: Cover roofs with layers of roofing felt or asphalt strips before installing tile, slate, or composition materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Roofing requires hazardous manual labor

tasks.text: Attach sheets of metal to roof boards or building frameworks when installing metal roofs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Roofing requires hazardous manual labor

tasks.text: Apply shingles, gravel, or asphalt over the top layer of tar to protect the roofing material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on spreading of loose materials

dwas.name: Spread sand, dirt or other loose materials onto surfaces.

tasks.text: Chop tar into small pieces, and heat chopped tar in kettles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.

tasks.text: Attach roofing paper and composition shingles, using nails.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Roofing requires hazardous manual labor

tasks.text: Place tiles, nail them to roof boards, and cover nailheads with roofing cement.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying sealants requires hands-on coating

dwas.name: Apply sealants or other protective coatings.
